indexes.scope: All ProjectFile Markdown schema entries at the 6.5.6 tag, split into choice, tag, attribute, structure and reference entries. Includes processes, time loop, solvers, variables, boundary/source terms, material and property definitions.
indexes.limitations: Documentation paths are identities, so identically named tags in different parents are distinct. This indexes authored configuration documentation and does not imply every native or extension factory is documented.

indexes.scope: Named benchmark content pages in the fixed source website; companion to the independent ProjectFile schema inventory.
indexes.limitations: The same physical mechanism can appear in several setups. Indexed pages can be numerical regression setups and do not certify the local application.

indexes.scope: Explicitly audited option values rejected by the native process factory.
indexes.limitations: Only additional implementation constraints reviewed for the newly added process cards are indexed here.

indexes.scope: 固定提交中的 processes、tools、tutorials 和 userguide 有正文页面逐页索引。
indexes.limitations: 纯导航 _index.md 排除；页面与其他 ProjectFile/benchmark 索引或工具源码可能描述相同功能，不能当成互不重叠的工程能力。

indexes.scope: 固定提交 Applications/Utils 下每个 C++ 源文件；注明可识别 CLI 入口或辅助实现。
indexes.limitations: C++ 文件不是独立能力总数：一个工具可跨多个文件，构建条件和系统依赖未自动确认；未把内部实现冒称可执行程序。
